camel_example: aliyun adcp GrantUserPermission --region cn-hangzhou --RoleName admin --ClusterId c102fe5f1ee5d4c87a68121a77d8b0000 --RoleType cluster --UserId 21760000
description_en: Grants Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) permissions to a Resource Access Management (RAM) user or RAM role. RAM system policies only control operation permissions on ACK One cluster resources, such as creating instances and viewing instance lists. If a RAM user or RAM role needs to manage Kubernetes resources within a specific cluster, such as creating GitOps applications and Argo workflows, the user or role must also obtain operation permissions, specifically RBAC permissions, on the specific ACK One cluster and its namespaces. This topic describes how to grant RBAC permissions to a RAM user or RAM role
description_zh: 为RAM用户或RAM角色授予RBAC权限。RAM系统策略仅控制ACK One集群资源的操作权限（例如创建实例、查看实例列表等），若RAM用户或RAM角色需要操作指定集群内的K8s资源，例如，创建GitOps Application和Argo Workflow等，还需要获取指定ACK One集群及其命名空间的操作权限即RBAC权限。本文为您介绍如何为RAM用户或RAM角色授予RBAC权限
kebab_example: aliyun adcp grant-user-permission --role-type cluster --role-name admin --cluster-id c102fe5f1ee5d4c87a68121a77d8b0000 --user-id 21760000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GrantUserPermission

parameters.help_en:
The authorization type. Valid values:

cluster: the cluster dimension.
namespace: the namespace dimension
parameters.help_zh:
授权类型，取值：

cluster：集群维度。
namespace: 命名空间维度
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en:
The preset role name. Valid values:

admin: administrator.
dev: developer.
gitops-dev: GitOps developer. This value is only applicable to fleet instances.

The relationship between the valid values of the RoleName parameter and the RoleType parameter is as follows:
If RoleType is set to cluster, this parameter can only be set to admin.
If RoleType is set to namespace, this parameter can only be set to dev or gitops-dev
parameters.help_zh:
预置的角色名称，取值：

admin: 管理员。
dev：开发人员。
gitops-dev: GitOps开发人员（仅限于舰队实例）。

RoleName参数取值和RoleType参数取值关系如下：
当RoleType取值为cluster时，本参数只能设置为admin。
当RoleType取值为namespace时，本参数只能设置为dev或gitops-dev
parameters.name: role_name

parameters.help_en:
The namespace name.

If RoleType is set to cluster, you do not need to specify this parameter.
If RoleType is set to namespace, you must specify this parameter.
If RoleType is set to namespace and RoleName is set to gitops-dev, you must specify this parameter and set it to argocd
parameters.help_zh:
命名空间名称。

当RoleType取值为cluster时，本参数无需设置。
当RoleType取值为namespace时，本参数必须填写。
当RoleType取值为namespace，且RoleName取值为gitops-dev时，本参数必须设置且只能设置为argocd
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The ID of the RAM user or RAM role
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the target entity to which permissions are granted is a RAM role. Set the value to `true` if the entity is a RAM role, or `false` otherwise
parameters.help_zh: 目标权限授予实体，如果是RAM角色，则为`true`，否则为`false`
parameters.name: is_ram_role
